data.title: AI-Generated Domain Lexical Pattern Detection
data.description: Detects domain registrations exhibiting lexical patterns consistent with AI-generated names: natural-language-like domain names that are grammatically plausible but not established brands, unusual TLD selection patterns, and registration in bulk with similar lexical characteristics. Large language models can produce domain names that bypass traditional DGA detection because they use real words and plausible constructions rather than random character strings. This rule identifies clusters of newly registered domains sharing lexical similarity scores above threshold, exhibiting natural-language n-gram distributions, and registered through the same registrar within a compressed time window. AI-generated domain portfolios tend to follow detectable stylistic patterns such as consistent word-count, hyphenation style, and semantic category clustering that distinguish them from organic registrations.

enrichment_required.source: DGA detection enrichment (Shannon entropy calculation for domain names)
NLP enrichment (word count analysis for domain structure)
NLP enrichment (lexical analysis score for domain naming patterns)

falsepositives: Legitimate brand portfolio registrations by marketing agencies
Domain investment companies registering descriptive keyword domains
New product launch campaigns registering multiple related domains
